pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

4. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   B. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   D. Say Myself has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
